name: qa-dispatch
description: Implementation (commit as post) -> dispatched specialty reviews -> PR flow

stages.name: in progress
stages.description: Agent implements the task, then commits as the stage's tail work

post.name: commit
post.prompt: Commit the relevant work for this task before QA review. Original task: $TASK_PROMPT

stages.name: review
stages.description: QA dispatcher selects the specialty reviews this branch needs, fans them out as child tasks, and aggregates their verdicts
stages.prompt: Dispatch the specialty reviews needed for branch $BRANCH against base $BASE_REF, then aggregate their verdicts into one review decision. Original task: $TASK_PROMPT.

stages.name: pr
stages.description: Agent creates a GitHub PR after dispatched QA passes
stages.prompt: Create a PR for the QA-approved work on branch $BRANCH.

post.name: approve
post.prompt: Approve the PR for branch $BRANCH after PR creation and signal the merge master. Previous result: $PREV_RESULT
